test_title: PYST 56: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The drug pedlar was arrested by the narcotics team.

options.text: The narcotics team was arrested the drug pedlar.
The narcotics team arrest the drug pedlar.
The narcotics team arrested the drug pedlar.
The narcotics team has arrested the drug pedlar.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: Object + was + V3 + by + Subject. (Simple past)
 
• Active voice structure: Subject + V2 + Object. (Simple past)
 
• The given sentence in passive voice is: "The drug pedlar was arrested by the narcotics team."
 
• The active voice version is: "The narcotics team arrested the drug pedlar."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The narcotics team arrested the drug pedlar."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The narcotics team was arrested the drug pedlar." – Incorrect grammar; "was" is unnecessary.
 
• **Option 2:** "The narcotics team arrest the drug pedlar." – Incorrect tense; it should be in the past tense.
 
• **Option 4:** "The narcotics team has arrested the drug pedlar." – Incorrect as it changes the tense to present perfect.
